sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Istiyaq Ali,Ali Hasan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ali Hasan, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Sunil Kumar, learned AGA for the State and also perused the material available on records.
2.
The applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in connection with Case Crime No. 806 of 2021, under Sections 411, 420, 468, 471 IPC and 66D I.T. Act, Police Station- Baradari, District- Bareilly.

3. At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicants have claimed parity with the co-accused Rashid Khan and Mustkeem Khan, who have already been granted anticipatory bail by another Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application u/s 438 Cr.P.C. Nos. 7849 of Irfan @ Irshad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95223792/
1 2022 and 7870 of 2022 vide orders dated 27.9.2022 and 11.10.2022.

entities.text: Irfan @ Irshad vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal history.

Since the case of the applicant is at par with the co-accused who have already been granted anticipatory bail till the submission of police report, the applicant is also entitled for the same on the ground of parity.
4. The prayer for anticipatory bail has been vehemently opposed by learned AGA.
However, the aforesaid factual aspect of the parity to the co-accused has not been disputed by him.
5. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the applicant deserves to be granted anticipatory bail in connection with the aforesaid case.

(Justice Krishan Pahal) Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Shalini  Irfan @ Irshad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95223792/
